name: seo-link-building-opportunities
summary: Turn approved backlink, content, topic, brand, and market evidence into ethical, prioritized link-building opportunities without outreach or link acquisition.
inputs: domain, target pages, offer, audience, market, and business goal
approved backlink, content, topic, Brand, PR, partnership, and competitor artifacts
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved market, publisher, or external page evidence
approval_gates: provider_availability: run bounded read-only checks against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before current provider, market, publisher, or external page reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
outreach: contact, submit, or pitch actions require a separate approved workflow and are out of scope
external_mutation: link buying, exchange, concealment, link creation, CMS, code, publishing, and production are out of scope
done_when: domain, targets, market, audience, goal, horizon, and research date are explicit
source status, freshness, and evidence labels are recorded
each opportunity has relevance, destination, editorial rationale, evidence, effort, risk, and owner
domain authority alone did not determine priority
required asset/proof and relationship basis are explicit
no spam, private-network, paid-link, exchange, concealment, or guaranteed outcome recommendation is present
outreach and asset handoffs preserve Strategy, Writing, Design, and approval ownership
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated opportunities or metrics
verify paid or credentialed calls had approval
verify outreach and link acquisition did not occur
verify no spam, private-network, paid-link, exchange, or concealment recommendation is present
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
